about: Each candidate item is checked by hand once; its verdict and reason are recorded here and census.py applies them. verdict 'issue' moves the item to the issues column; 'ok' moves it to a reported 'checked, not an issue' row with this reason. An item no decision matches stays a candidate. 'category' is the start of the candidate row's name; 'pattern' a regular expression searched in the item.
